sutta: The next sutta is 48.41. On one occasion, the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthi in the Eastern Park, in the mansion of Migara's mother. Migara's mother is a nickname for Visakha. Now, on that occasion, the Blessed One had emerged from seclusion in the evening and was sitting warming his back in the last rays of the sun. Uh that means the sun was setting down. It was uh going down, now. And uh the monks came out of seclusion. Then the venerable Ananda approached the Blessed One. Having approached and paid homage, while massaging the Blessed One's limbs, he said to him, "It is wonderful, venerable sir. It is amazing, venerable sir. The Blessed One's complexion is no longer pure and bright. His limbs are all flaccid and wrinkled. His body is stooped, and and some alteration is seen in his faculties. In the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty." And the Buddha said, "So it is, Ananda. In youth, one is subject to aging. In health, one is subject to illness. While alive, one is subject to death. The complexion is no longer pure and bright. The limbs are all flaccid and wrinkled. The body is stooped, and some alteration is seen in the faculties. In the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, the body faculty." This is what the Blessed One said. Having said this, the fortunate one, the teacher, uh also said, "Fie on you, wretched aging. Aging which makes beauty fade. So much has the charming puppet been crushed beneath advancing age. One who might live 100 years also has death as destination. Death spares none along the way, but comes crushing everything." That's the end of the sutta. So you see, when the Buddha was young, uh he used to constantly meditate, now, and emit a lot of light, now. That's he's uh nickname was Angirasa. Kinsman of the sun, relative of the sun. The sun is always so bright. But when the Buddha was old at this time, he must have been about 80 years old. Uh then the Buddha is no longer his complexion uh no longer pure and bright like before. And his limbs are all uh all his hands and all that are wrinkled and the skin becomes softer. Body also bent already uh like a hunchback a bit uh stoop. And in his the eye and the ear and nose and tongue and body all uh there's some change. Don't look so handsome anymore the Buddha. So everyone is like that. When we are young uh uh when you are very young, you look especially like children, they look very cute everybody. Even puppies also look very cute now they young. But uh as you grow older, you start to change. So after 40, then you know because at the age of about 40, uh we have this uh fluctuation in our eye faculty. Look far and uh look far and you cannot read the newspaper small letters, I have to put far away and uh So after 40, you go downhill very fast. Uh all the beauty will fade away. And become more and more ugly looking. So even uh even the Buddha is not spared. So if we constantly think of this uh then we should quickly use our time because uh as you grow older, we become weaker. You see old people you go to any meditation center, you see uh people meditating, usually it is a old people uh their heads will be bent.
